title: Merge two lines
summary: Arbitrate two feeders that share one outfeed: give line A priority, let one box through at a time and interlock the two blades.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Arbitrate two requests with a priority: line A wins when both lines wait.
Interlock two outputs so they are never active together, and release the grant only when the box has cleared the merge.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/MergeLines.st, keep two grant memories, GrantA and GrantB: grant line A first when both wait, grant a line only when no grant is active and the merge zone is empty, and end the grant when its box has left the zone.
stages.checkpoint: HoldA and HoldB are true unless that line has the grant, so the two blades are never open together.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, think about the merge point: both feeders carry boxes, but the outfeed fits one box at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Both blades hold the lines at first; then one blade opens at a time, line A first, and the next opens only after the box has left the zone; all six boxes leave and Done turns on.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter drives no output, so nothing is loaded and no blade moves; load three boxes on each feeder, open one blade at a time, with line A first, never both together, and open the next only when the previous box has left the merge zone.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named merge-lines and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch which blade opens first and how the second line waits; no two boxes meet in the merge.
stages.checkpoint: All six boxes are delivered in turn, no box collides or drops, and Done is on at the end.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The ALWAYS assertion on collisions is the interlock check: a design that opened both blades could pass the delivery check and still fail it.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: A grant is a latch: set GrantA when WaitA is TRUE and nothing is granted and the zone is empty, otherwise set GrantB when WaitB is TRUE (the order of the IF and ELSIF is the priority).

Remember that the zone sensor saw the box (a Seen memory) and clear both grants when the zone goes from TRUE to FALSE (an F_TRIG); then HoldA := Active AND NOT GrantA and HoldB := Active AND NOT GrantB.

faultCases: The starter drives no output, so nothing is loaded and no blade moves; load three boxes on each feeder, open one blade at a time, with line A first, never both together, and open the next only when the previous box has left the merge zone.
